title: Brother Johnny, sister Viola and young Reb's first jobs in Los Angeles
summary: Johnny the pianist and Viola the concert pianist; the family moves to Los Angeles, Reb sells papers and delivers special delivery mail until Johnny returns in 1907 with a set of drums.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Johnny, the one that wrote all the music with me. And my sister turned out to be a great pianist.

That's Viola. She travelled all over the world playing piano--concert work and so forth. She travelled with the Jubilee Singers...the Tuskegee Jubilee Singers...for awhile until she married and settled down. She was quite a pianist. And then when we moved to Los Angeles, why I was seven...eight years old, and I started selling newspapers on the streets and such things as that and going to school and after the Galveston flood--I think it was in '98...something like that--I was getting a little older, and I started to riding a bicycle, working as a messenger boy for the different stores and things, delivering packages and even about 1902-3, I become postal...uh, United States Special Delivery in the Post Office, and I worked in that for awhile until my brother came home, and he had been travelling as a musician. In 19 and 07, why he came home and he says...he bought me a set of drums, and he says, "I'm gonna take you with me," and he taught me--I started playing drums and he on the piano.
